title: Bet $5 a day for 5 days, get up to $250 in Bonus Bets
eligibility: New customers; eligible jurisdictions only; age and location rules apply
description: New customers can earn up to $50 in Bonus Bets per day by placing one eligible $5+ real-money wager each day for five consecutive days after opting in.
steps: Sign up and verify your FanDuel Sportsbook account
Deposit at least $5
Opt in to the promotion
Place one eligible $5+ cash wager each day for five consecutive days
Receive up to $50 in Bonus Bets per qualifying day
notes: Bonus Bets expire 7 days after receipt. Gambling promotions are not available in every state. Gambling Problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER.
scout_reason: Bonus Bets are not cash and generally cannot be withdrawn directly. Scout Value discounts the $250 face value and also accounts for five days of qualifying wagers and wagering risk.

title: Open 360 Checking and earn $250
expires: No end date shown on current official offer page
eligibility: Eligible new 360 Checking customers; account approval required
description: Open a new 360 Checking account with promo code CHECKING250 and receive two qualifying direct deposits of at least $500 each within 75 days.
steps: Open a new Capital One 360 Checking account
Use promo code CHECKING250
Receive at least two qualifying direct deposits of $500+ each within 75 days
Keep the account open and in good standing
Capital One deposits the $250 bonus after qualification
notes: Capital One states the bonus may take up to 60 days after the 75-day qualification period. Bonus may be tax-reportable.
scout_reason: Cash reward receives close to full value, with a small discount for the two $500 direct-deposit requirement and long payout window.

title: Open and fund a brokerage account; earn up to $1,500
eligibility: New eligible non-retirement brokerage account; additional terms and funding tiers apply
description: E*TRADE is advertising a limited-time cash-credit offer for new eligible brokerage accounts funded with qualifying deposits using promo code OFFER26.
steps: Open one new eligible E*TRADE self-directed brokerage account
Use promo code OFFER26
Fund the account with at least $1,000 of qualifying assets within 60 days
Meet the applicable funding tier and retention requirements
Receive the corresponding cash credit
notes: The advertised maximum is $1,500; actual bonus depends on funding tier. Investments involve risk.
scout_reason: The $1,500 headline is the maximum funding tier. Scout Value heavily discounts it because the actual reward depends on funding level, capital requirements, retention rules, and investment-account complexity.

title: Premium Savings bonus up to $800
eligibility: New Premium Savings Account; qualifying net-new funds required
description: Open a new Premium Savings Account and deposit qualifying net-new funds. The first published tier starts at $20,000 and pays a $400 cash credit; higher tiers can earn up to $800.
steps: Open a new E*TRADE Premium Savings Account
Deposit at least $20,000 in qualifying net-new funds within 30 days
Maintain the required balance for the applicable period
Receive the cash credit for your funding tier
notes: Minimum qualifying deposit is $20,000. The maximum advertised bonus is $800; review official tier requirements before opening.
scout_reason: Cash reward is valuable, but the $20,000+ qualifying balance and maintenance period create a substantial capital burden. The $800 headline is also the maximum tier.

title: New riders: 50% off first ride, up to $10
eligibility: New riders; terms and availability apply
description: Lyft's official homepage currently advertises 50% off a new rider's first ride, capped at $10, using code 50OFF1WB.
steps: Create an eligible new Lyft rider account
Enter promo code 50OFF1WB
Book your first eligible ride
Receive 50% off, up to $10
notes: Offer terms, geography and eligibility may change. Confirm the code in Lyft before booking.
scout_reason: The discount is easy to use if you already need a ride. Scout Value is close to face value with a small usability discount.

title: Eligible first-time members: 4-week free trial
expires: No end date shown on current official page
description: Uber currently offers eligible first-time members a four-week free Uber One trial before the standard $9.99/month membership price.
steps: Open Uber or Uber Eats
Confirm you are eligible for the first-time-member trial
Activate the 4-week Uber One trial
Cancel before renewal if you do not want the paid membership
notes: Trial eligibility varies. Membership renews at the applicable price unless canceled according to Uber's terms.
scout_reason: A free trial is useful only if the membership benefits are valuable to you, and it can renew into a paid subscription if not canceled.
